pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to losing positions; pyramiding only permitted after existing position reaches +$10.00 floating profit with stop-loss moved to breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require Volume-Weighted Average Price (VWAP) divergence confirmation and a zero-spread macro liquidity window before any 0.01 lot order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate tranches of aggressive peak harvesting the moment floating profit hits +$12.00 to lock in gains before mean-reversion wicks occur.
